description.en: The list of unique data asset IDs.

description.zh:
数据资产类型

- 数据表（ACS::DataWorks::Table）

- 调度任务（ACS::DataWorks::Task）
description.en:
The Asset Type of the data asset. Valid values:

- ACS::DataWorks::Table: table.

- ACS::DataWorks::Task: scheduling node.

description.zh:
数据资产所属的工作空间环境，包括
- Dev（开发环境）
- Prod（生产环境）
description.en:
The workspace environment to which the data asset belongs. Valid values:
- Dev: development environment.
- Prod: production environment.
The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
数据资产关联的标签列表，基于标签做查询过滤：
- 多个值之间是“或”的关系，比如`["key1:v1", "key2:v1", "key3:v1"]`底层查询包含任一一个标签的数据资产。
- 不传递，或者传递为空表示不作tag过滤。
description.en:
The list of tags associated with data assets. Tags are used as query filters:
- Multiple values have an OR relationship. For example, `["key1:v1", "key2:v1", "key3:v1"]` queries data assets that contain any of the specified tags.
- If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, no tag-based filtering is applied.

description.zh:
用户输入的自定义标签键。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`dw:`开头，仅支持中英文数字和部分符号`-@#*<>|[]()+=&%$!~`。
description.en:
The custom tag key.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, cannot start with `dw:`, and supports only letters, digits, and the following special characters: `-@#*<>|[]()+=&%$!~`.

title.zh: 查询已关联标签的资产列表
title.en: Query data assets associated with tags

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks企业版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Enterprise Edition or a higher edition to use this feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-assets --tags Value=value Key=key --data-asset-ids 7000069357000 --data-asset-type ACS::DataWorks::Task --project-id 10000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --env-type Prod --asset-domain-id 1001 --category-uuid cate-xxxxxxxx --name '资产域名称' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDataAssets --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --ProjectId 10000 --AssetDomainId 1001 --DataAssetIds '["7000069357000"]' --DataAssetType 'ACS::DataWorks::Task' --CategoryUuid 'cate-xxxxxxxx' --Tags '[{"Value":"value","Key":"key"}]' --EnvType Prod --Name '资产域名称'
